description: Daily PLA ad-request and non-zero-response volume for a marketplace over a period, one row per day. Exposes the date dimension and the raw requests and responses aggregates; response% is derived in the Python layer.

date.description: The calendar day the PLA ad requests were received (per-day grouping).

requests.selector: COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN pf.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN pf.requests ELSE 0 END), 0)
requests.description: PLA ad requests received on this day.

responses.selector: COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN pf.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN pf.non_zero_responses ELSE 0 END), 0)
responses.description: PLA ad requests that returned at least one ad (non-zero responses) on this day.

query.REPORTING: SELECT __ATTRIBUTES__, __METRICS__ FROM `prj-onlinesales-prod-01.reporting.os_product_ads_page_name_performance_facts` AS pf JOIN `prj-onlinesales-prod-01.reporting.marketplace_clients` AS mc ON pf.marketplace_client_id = mc.marketplace_client_id WHERE mc.agency_id = '__AGENCY_ID__' AND pf.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' AND pf.date >= '2022-07-11' AND pf.page_type IS NOT NULL AND pf.page_type NOT IN ('', 'NA') AND __FILTER__ GROUP BY __ATTRIBUTES_GROUP_BY__;
